name: Jenny Clark

text.trigger: Jenny searches while her player is still in the colony.
text.vignette: On the long road a lone shape is limping forward with a loose crowd of the dead behind her. The lookout knows the walk before the face, and the rifle is already up.

options.let-her-in: Open the gate for her: Jenny moves to the colony and 8 zombies are added there.
options.take-the-shot: End it from a distance: Jenny Clark dies.
